While essential in the 1900s and early 2000s, third party apps that deal hand anti-virus, anti-malware, security and firewall functions are generally not needed in modern systems. Windows Defender and Windows Firewall will almost certainly do everything you need.

Third Party apps can also be dangerous to your privacy. Apps like Avast, AVG, Avira and Norton are all owned by Gen Digital which has a history of using AV apps as [spyware](https://consumer.ftc.gov/consumer-alerts/2024/02/software-provider-avast-will-pay-165-million-compromising-consumers-privacy).

When it comes to your PC's security, always remember the golden rule: DCSS (Don't Click Stupid Stuff). Pirated apps and movies, some third party hacks and cheats and some other untrusted content should be avoided.
